prompt:
The attached image is a frame from this shot. Continue it from exactly this frame, in a single continuous shot, at real speed. The view stays fixed and level, locked off. The man in the foreground is bellowing at the seated man for the whole eight seconds, from the first frame to the last, and the back of his head stays toward the camera throughout. His head and shoulders jerk forward with each word, the cords of his neck tighten, and his pointing hand jabs toward the seated man in short hard stabs with the finger held straight; rain flicks off his wet hair each time his head snaps. Near the end he runs out of breath, his shoulders heave once and his arm sinks a little, still pointing. The seated man stays exactly where he is and holds his eyes on him, breathing slowly, blinking once, his mouth closed throughout. Rain keeps falling at real speed through the lamp's light and runs off the coat and the tent.

Audio: heavy rain on tarmac and on the tent, water dripping from a gutter. No music and no voices.

Thanks.
